_about: Kinds for tt-model bundles whose card gives no Hugging Face task tag. This is an inference, made by reading the weights repo name, the publisher and the bundle manifest, and each entry says why. The builder applies an entry only when no task tag is stated, and the site marks the kind as inferred. A model not listed here stays 'task not stated'. Keyed by the weights repo in the manifest, lower case. Kinds reuse the names already on the site (LLM, Image generation, Video generation, Text to audio, Robotics, Object detection, Image segmentation) and add Depth and 3D geometry and Computer vision.

allenai/olmo-3.1-32b-instruct.basis: An instruct language model; the bundle names an olmo3_tt tool-call parser.
